Name: Ripen
Effect: The User is not required to Hold/Consume a Berry to use Moves that Require them or gain an additional effect from them. Additionally those same Moves gain +1 Damage Dice. (Berry-Type effects chosen at the Storytellers discretion).
Description: The Pokémon can ripen fruits and berries in no time to make them Extra sweet and delicious, healing berries will have their effects boosted.
